limits: Remote PR scope is open PRs including drafts. Closed work is searched through local READMEs, TASK metadata and ledger only. Local coverage compares searched working-tree notes with regular note paths at coverage.local.head; it does not certify HEAD contents or historical coverage. No code diffs or arbitrary package files are searched. Recheck relevant heads before submission.
note: One cached task-shaped search supplements live reading of current PR/discussion text; this report proposes targets and claims neither novelty nor completed investigations.
